content: Nnando ghuulinga hilyo hiyambikilitwe ming'omong'omo. Kulyaghila “Twabhoha tubhegha na utendehi handa pannongela” peni utendehi aghwo ghungubhatenda bhandu abheghe bha kuliloka, ngati upalo ghunguatenda atangalo atengeleke mu kuhyubhalila.
Mundu ywoheli ywakahwacha kukita kangumanya kilibhi, kulyaghila kangumanya ng'obhe kyoheli handa payinnoghela.
Peni mundu pakampala Chapanga, mundu aywo kangumanyikwa Chapanga.
Kya habhu, nhalo ghwa kuhilyegha hilibhi hiibhuhitwe kwa kya ming'omung'omu, tungumanya kukita “Ming'omung'omu chepa kilibhi munnima, peni tungumanya kukita Chapanga kabhegha yumu ghweka.”
Hata payibhele bhandu bhangulongela hibhegha hilibhi hingukemwa, machapanga, hya kunane ku bhwelo ebu pannima, na hata payibhele abhegha, machapanga, atangalo na akaabambo atangalo,

peni kwa twenga kabhegha Chapanga yumu, aywo ndo Tate, ywakabhumbite hilibhi hyoha na kwa ywombe twenga tungutama nga tuntumikile ywombe, na kabhegha Bambo yumu ghweka ndo Yesu Kilisito, kwakukindila ywombe hilibhi hyoha hikibhumbwa na kwa kukindila ywombe twenga tungutama.

Peni, chepa bhandu bhoha bhangumanya uhoto aghu. Kiyaha abhegha bhandu atangalo ahyobhelela kutundamila ming'omong'omo, mbaka hinu paalyegha hilyo ahyo, hinguatenda ahwache hiyambikilwa ming'omung'omo. Habhu, bhangulibhona atenda ulemwa kiyaha bhanakamala ng'obhe mu kuhyubhalila.
Peni hilyo kinguhotola ng'obhe kutuhegheleha ugheghela na Chapanga, patuleka kulyegha tungupelelwa ng'obhe na kilibhi, handa patulyegha tunguyonjokehwa ng'obhe kilibhi.
Peni mulindakile, ulekekeho ghwenu ghukotoke kuatenda ayoyobhalo bha kuhyubhalila bhaaponekela mu ulemwa.

Kiyaha handa mundu ywakabheghite na uhyubhalilo nnyoyoho, pakaabhona mwenga mummeghite na utendehi, mungulyegha mu nyumba ya kutundamila ming'omong'omo, bhuli, kaanyeghelehwa ng'obhe kulyegha hilibhi hiiyambikilitwe ming'omong'omo?
Habhu, aywo nnongo yunauhyubhalilo nnyoyoho, ywene Kilisito kakihwegha kwa kya ywombe, kaakanjaghanwa kubhukana na utendehi ghwako.
Kya habhu, handa pamuatenda bhangi ahokele kwa umanyi ghwenu, na kubhanyengemala bhaabheghite na uhyubhalilo nnyoyoho, maabhgha mungunhokela Kilisito,
kya habhu handa ghula mulyo ghunughulyegha kingunnyambuha Nhyubhalila nnyoyoho. Nenga ndaalyegha ng'obhe nyama ngotoke kuntenda nhyubhalila nnyangu kaponekele muulemwa.
